parsed.summary: The paper introduces LLM4AIGQ, a framework for generating AI guidance queries tailored to users' multi-interests in e-commerce. It employs a three-stage training pipeline (SFT, RL, DPO) to improve the quality and relevance of generated queries. The framework demonstrates strong performance in both offline evaluations and online A/B tests, showing significant improvements in user engagement metrics.

chk_problem.value: Traditional AI-generated queries suffer from semantic drift and fail to capture user multi-interests, leading to low-value guidance queries.
chk_problem.paper_quote: This approach suffers from semantic drift due to information cascade loss; additionally, primary search query derivation heavily depends on 'user-item' co-occurrence relationships, lacking exploration of user multi-interests, resulting in guidance queries with low value and mismatched purchase intent.

chk_method.value: LLM4AIGQ framework with a three-stage SFT–RL–DPO training pipeline for multi-interest-aware AI guidance query generation.
chk_method.paper_quote: In summary, we propose LLM4AIGQ, an LLM-based framework for multi-interest-aware AI guidance query generation, with a three-stage SFT–RL–DPO training pipeline.

chk_data.value: Datasets sampled from Taobao and Tmall user interaction logs from June to July 2026, with 8,000 instances for short-title fine-tuning and 11,259 instances for SFT training.
chk_data.paper_quote: Our datasets are sampled from multi-behavior user interaction logs on the Taobao and Tmall e-commerce platforms, covering the period from June to July 2026.

chk_setup.value: LLM4AIGQ uses Qwen3-30B-A3B as the backbone model, trained on NVIDIA H20 GPUs with specific configurations for SFT, RL, and DPO stages.
chk_setup.paper_quote: LLM4AIGQ adopts Qwen3-30B-A3B as the backbone model and is trained on NVIDIA H20 GPUs.

chk_primary_result.value: LLM4AIGQ-ONESFT+RL+DPO achieves Recall@10 of 0.2101 and S ratio of 0.8616 on the Taobao dataset.

chk_secondary_result.value: LLM4AIGQ-ONESFT+RL+DPO achieved a 4.46% improvement in uCTR in a 10% traffic online A/B test and maintained a 2.53% gain in a 40% traffic test over six days.
chk_secondary_result.paper_quote: In the initial 10% traffic experiment, the experimental group achieved a 4.46% improvement in uCTR compared with the baseline bucket. After scaling the traffic to 40%, the overall uCTR still maintained a positive gain of 2.53% over six days of online validation, demonstrating strong generalization capability and online stability under larger-scale deployment.

chk_baseline.value: LLM4AIGQ is compared against zero-shot LLMs and variants of itself, including Qwen3-30B-A3B, Qwen3.5-122B-A10B, and Deepseek-V4-Pro.
chk_baseline.paper_quote: We compare LLM4AIGQ with two major types of baselines: (1) zero-shot LLMs, including several advanced models and larger variants from the same model family, all evaluated without any domain adaptation; and (2) variants of LLM4AIGQ.

chk_conclusion.value: LLM4AIGQ effectively generates high-quality, multi-interest-aware AI guidance queries and demonstrates strong performance in both offline and online evaluations.
chk_conclusion.paper_quote: In this work, to address issues in traditional shopping guidance query generation pipelines, such as semantic drift and the inability to capture personalized user intent, we propose an LLM-based AI guidance query generation framework for multi-interest users.

chk_limitation.reason: The paper does not explicitly discuss limitations or implications of the proposed method.
